text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All doooone!!
All riiiight, let's try it again this time around!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ticket-san! Are you making sweets?
What an adorable little bunny!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's still just a prototype though!
Care to give it a taste test?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure?!
Then don't mind if I do—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: CHOWAAAAA~?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that was the reason behind that scream
earlier, was it...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaah!!
I'm so sorry, Bakushin Oooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside, why are you making sweets?
If you'd like, would you tell us the story?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *sniff*, *sob*, you see, the thing is——

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We couldn't buy the sweets from Yuki-chan's memories,
so I tried making something else instead.
She was really happy with it back then, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted her to taste the real deal!
I kept searching after that, but sales ended before I could buy anyyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I just... I just...!
I felt so totally frustrated leaving it like thissss!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—So I thought, why not recreate it myself and have her eat that!
...Or so I hoped...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's not turning out well AT ALLLLLL!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see... If that's the case,
please allow us to lend a hand.
I would love to help out too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll look up recipe recreations right away!
Let's do our best for Yukino-chan's sake♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I shall assist as well!!
Leave everything to your class president!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah!!
Thank you both so muuuuuch!!!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then let us begin♪
First, we start by mixing the shiratamako flour with water.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Roger that! Let's do thisss!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin! Bakushin! Bakushiiin!!
Stir in an exemplary fashioooon!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa?!
Wait, wait up~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, what? What's wrong??

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The ingredients are splattering all over the place,
so it would be best to ease up on the strength a little.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Nerikiri has a delicate and soft atmosphere, right?
So I think it would turn out better if we stirred more gently♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, gently, is it!!
Then I shall modulate my strength with all my might!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Me too!!
Sounds tricky, but I'll give it everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I-It's doooone!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My word, who knew adjusting one's strength could be so difficult!
However! All's well that ends well!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to hand it over to Yukino-chan, but...
Ticket-san? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm.
Somehow, looking at this little guy really reminds me of something...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah!! It's Yuki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's white and soft and super cute!!
Right?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan? Ah, now that you mention it, definitely...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know♪
If I just do this like so... and...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: As an experiment, I tried making one with a little Yukino-chan style flair♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!
It's Yuki-chan's headband!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ It was just a spur-of-the-moment idea, so it could still use some refinement though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's make it look waaay more like Yuki-chan!
And we'll give it to her together with the snow bunny!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do that!
First, let's brainstorm some ideas!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do our besttt!!

I saw Winning Ticket and the others in the kitchen
working hard on making sweets.
Watching their earnest efforts warmed my heart.
